verifiedOutcomes: An exact private Telegram-v2 owner command can durably enqueue one bounded tool-free research task, read its workboard status and request stop.
A separate worker uses the official OpenAI SDK through one sealed provider profile and one durable call-start fence.
Two workers do not start the same model call twice and a restart after call-start does not replay it.
An owner stop during an active call survives restart, cancels the local SDK call cooperatively and prevents result delivery.
Stop versus success and stop versus failure share one lock order and one durable winner without deadlock.
The same stop message ID returns the same wording before and after worker completion.
A lost worker after a stored stop request is shown as contact lost and ambiguous, never as confirmed stopped.
The narrow worker image starts from the exact dependency lock and passes its real database and lease health preflight under bounded container settings.
The resident image command reaches Docker healthy state, stops gracefully with exit code 0, writes no runtime log content and leaves no worker container behind.
nonClaims: No external OpenAI or Codex request, provider charge or provider-side cancellation was tested.
No real Telegram network message, managed-B deployment, production A change or user acceptance occurred.
The candidate image is local, untagged and unsigned; it has no source-commit label or repository digest, and no registry provenance, SBOM, vulnerability scan or multi-architecture build is claimed.

The main run observed an offline no-pull/no-cache build, but its redirected build log is empty; the precise build invocation is therefore not independently reopenable and no reproducible image ID is claimed.
The 24 wheel files were hash-checked against the lock, but approved artifact-proxy provenance is not yet proven.
The worker is tool-free and handles one task at a time; tool grants, parallel child trees and interactive Harness fork/join remain separate work.
SIGKILL after call-start remains an uncertain external outcome that Eva reports and never blindly repeats.
Managed B remains on its existing schema and image authority; 4e_0004 is a clean-candidate schema only.
